## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry helper exceeds the five-attempt limit in the supplied project policy. Correct the default and accepted maximum before merging.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — When an upstream consistently raises `OSError`, the default call makes ten attempts, and line 19 also permits explicit counts above the supplied policy’s five-attempt cap. Please cap both the default and accepted maximum at five and update the documentation and tests accordingly. — A failed upstream receives twice the permitted requests per default call, increasing load and delaying failure propagation.

(none)

## Strengths
- Tests verify recovery after failures, exhaustion, rejection of out-of-range attempt counts, and no sleep after a single exhausted attempt.
